option_relations.rationale: The option describes recurrent postpartum mastitis and lactotroph hyperplasia, which aligns with the leaf's description of recurrent right breast mastitis and hyperprolactinemia (lactotroph hyperplasia can lead to hyperprolactinemia).
Hyperprolactinemia is explicitly mentioned as a contributing factor in the leaf, indicating it's a manifestation or component of the overall clinical picture described by the leaf.
The breast ultrasound explicitly states 'No abscess or focal lesion in the right breast', ruling out a subclinical breast abscess.
Bacterial mastitis due to Streptococcus agalactiae is the direct cause of the mastitis component of the leaf's diagnosis.
